query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create and refine a Google Slides presentation by inspecting existing slides and layouts, adding styled slides, inserting an image, and verifying the rendered result.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if you need a branded starting point)] [Prerequisite]: Duplicate a template using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_COPY_FROM_TEMPLATE (capture new presentationId).

[Optional (if generating many text-heavy slides from Markdown)] [Step]: Create-and-populate slides using GOOGLESLIDES_CREATE_SLIDES_MARKDOWN (split slides with '---'; retain returned presentation_id/presentationId for follow-up edits).

[Optional (if slide order, layouts/masters, or IDs are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect deck structure using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET (use a narrow fields mask to collect slides(objectId) and needed layout/master refs).

[Optional (if targeting specific elements or confirming a slide’s layout)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch page-only details using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_PAGES_GET (read slideProperties.* and pageElements[].objectId).
[Optional (if you need custom visuals)] [Prerequisite]: Generate image assets using GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE (retain URL for later insertion).

[Required] [Step]: Apply all mutations using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE (create slides/shapes, insertText, updateTextStyle/updateParagraphStyle, insert images; send either markdown_text OR requests per call; split large change-sets into multiple calls).
[Optional (if slide order must be corrected after inserts)] [Step]: Reposition slides using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE (updateSlidesPosition in a follow-up call).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Confirm slide count/order and key objectIds using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET (fields="slides(objectId)").
[Optional (for visual QA)] [Next Step]: Spot-check layout using GOOGLESLIDES_GET_PAGE_THUMBNAIL2 (use a slide pageObjectId; review data.contentUrl).
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE] 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT when createSlide.objectId is too short (observed length must be >=5); retries may create duplicates unless removed with deleteObject.
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE] Provide either 'requests' OR 'markdown_text' per call; combining both is rejected—split into multiple calls.
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE] 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT if createSlide.slideLayoutReference.layoutId doesn’t exist in the current master (layout/master mismatch).

[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE] Request ordering matters when mixing deleteObject/create/update; markdown expansions can push requestCount into the hundreds and make responses huge/truncated.
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] 403 PERMISSION_DENIED / ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT can occur; unconstrained fields may return very large responses—use a tight fields mask.

GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE.description: Update Google Slides presentations using markdown content or raw API text. Supports professional themes, auto-formatting, and multiple slide types (title, bullet, table, quote, image, two-column).

requests.description:
List of update requests, each a dict with one of these valid Slides API request types:

**Common requests:** createSlide, createShape, createTable, createImage, insertText, updateTextStyle, updateShapeProperties, updatePageProperties, updateParagraphStyle, deleteObject, updateTableCellProperties, updateTableColumnProperties, replaceAllText

**IMPORTANT:** To update slide backgrounds, use `updatePageProperties` (NOT `updateSlideProperties`). The field `pageBackgroundFill` exists in PageProperties, not SlideProperties.

Required if markdown_text is not provided.

requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID the updates must be applied to. If set, the batchUpdate will only succeed if the presentation's current revision ID matches this value.

writeControl.description: Options that control how write requests are executed.

markdown_text.description:
Markdown content to add as new slides to an existing presentation. Separate slides with '
---
'. Each slide auto-detects its type from content. Slide types: title ('# Title
Subtitle'), bullets ('-'/'+'/'*'), tables (markdown tables), quotes ('> text'), images ('![alt](URL)'), two-column ('|||' separator), plain text. Add 'Theme: <name>' as the first line to apply a theme. Available themes: default, corporate_blue, modern_dark, professional_gray, creative_purple, warm_orange, forest_green, minimal_beige. Font sizes auto-scale based on content length (28pt down to 8pt). Supports **bold**, emoji, and auto-centering of tables. Images must be publicly accessible URLs (PNG/JPEG/GIF, <50MB).

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to apply the updates to.

GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET.description: Tool to retrieve the latest version of a presentation. Use after obtaining the presentation ID.

fields.description: Comma-separated selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Nested fields use parentheses that must be properly balanced. Top-level fields: presentationId, title, locale, revisionId, pageSize, slides, masters, layouts, notesMaster. For slides/masters/layouts, valid Page fields: objectId, pageType, pageElements, pageProperties, revisionId. For pageElements, valid fields: objectId, size, transform, title, description, shape, image, video, line, table, wordArt, elementGroup, sheetsChart, speakerSpotlight. For shape, valid fields: shapeType, text, shapeProperties, placeholder. Note: 'autofit' is under shapeProperties, not directly under shape. Use shape(shapeProperties(autofit)), not shape(autofit). Examples: 'presentationId,title', 'slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,size))', 'slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,shape(shapeType,text,shapeProperties(autofit))))'

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to retrieve. Either presentation_id or presentation_name must be provided.

presentationName.description: The name of the presentation to search for and retrieve. If provided, the action will search Google Drive for a presentation with this name. Either presentation_id or presentation_name must be provided.

GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_PAGES_GET.description: Tool to get the latest version of a specific page in a presentation. Use when you need to inspect slide, layout, master, or notes page details.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the page to retrieve.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation from which to fetch the page.
